# Shelf

> Open source asset management platform enabling teams to track, book, and audit equipment with QR-based location tracking and conflict-free reservation workflows.

Shelf is a free, open-source asset management solution designed for teams managing shared equipment across multiple locations. It serves diverse industries including education, utilities, media production, and research institutions, with proven success in reducing asset loss, preventing double bookings, and streamlining equipment workflows.

## Key Topics

- Asset Management
- Equipment Tracking
- Location Tracking
- Equipment Booking
- QR Labels
- Custody Tracking
- Inventory Management
- Asset Audits
- Workflow Optimization
- Multi-Location Management
- Equipment Kits
- Open Source
- Team Collaboration
- Asset Recovery
- Conflict Prevention

## Core Features

- [Equipment Booking Software — Conflict-Free Reservations](https://www.shelf.nu/features/bookings): Shelf equipment booking feature with conflict prevention
- [Equipment Location Tracking Software](https://www.shelf.nu/features/location-tracking): Shelf location tracking feature with QR-based updates
- [Custody Tracking for Shared Equipment](https://www.shelf.nu/features/custody): Shelf custody tracking feature with accountability trails
- [Asset Audits — Physical Inventory Verification](https://www.shelf.nu/features/audits): Shelf physical audit feature with QR scanning and reporting
- [Asset Pages — Complete Asset Profiles](https://www.shelf.nu/features/asset-pages): Shelf asset detail pages with profiles and history
- [Equipment Kits & Accessory Tracking](https://www.shelf.nu/features/kits): Shelf kit bundling and accessory tracking feature
